summary: The CHANGELOG Breaking table has no row for the other control characters 0.36.0 accepted and 0.37 refuses: U+0001-0008, U+000E-001A, U+001C-001F, U+007F, U+0080-009F except U+0085 (real-binary old-vs-new: scenario new --actor, finding add --summary, subject move --reason and --override-reason, divergence add --actor all take a\x7fb and a\x9fb in 0.36.0 and refuse them now, in all 43 cells of the six options). The class list stops at escape-inside and vt-ff-inside and the golden option_values_0_36.json never measured them, so atip.optionvalues.14 cannot see the gap; brief F7 wants a row for every newly refused value. Add a class (e.g. other-control) to the golden and to the rows of every cell the control rule is new for.
